title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen - Ryoushu no Youjo
synopsis: Anime adaptation of part three of the Honzuki no Gekokujou light novel.

node.title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen 3rd Season
Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen - Kizokuin no Toshokan wo Sukuitai!

episodes_data.title: I've Become a Noble
episodes_data.description: Myne begins her new life as Rosemyne. Her first challenge is to complete the baptism and adoption ceremonies!

episodes_data.title: Lower City Family Reunion
episodes_data.description: After the baptism ceremony and adoption, Rosemyne returns to the cathedral to become the high bishop.

episodes_data.title: Archduke's Castle and Italian Restaurant
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne officially moves into the castle and Sylvester finally eats at the Italian restaurant.

episodes_data.title: How to Collect Donations
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne tries to collect donations from the nobility, but finds it harder than she thought...

episodes_data.title: Concert Preparations
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne puts all her efforts into preparing for the harspiel concert.

episodes_data.title: Harspiel Concert
episodes_data.description: Everything is falling into place for the concert. All that`s left is to guard against one person...

episodes_data.title: Hasse's Monastery
episodes_data.description: The monastery in Hasse is now ready. Rosemyne goes for the final inspection and to accept new children.

episodes_data.title: Ferdinand's Task
episodes_data.description: Ferdinand gives Rosemyne the task to entrap and isolate the mayor of Hasse.

episodes_data.title: Wilfried's Day as High Bishop
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne finally gets fed up with Wilfried`s complaints and offers to switch spots with him for a day.

episodes_data.title: First Material Gathering
episodes_data.description: The Harvest Festival is coming up and Rosemyne prepares to gather materials for her jureve for the first time.

episodes_data.title: The Gathering of Gutenbergs
episodes_data.description: To improve the printing press, Ingo is even willing to exchange ideas between different trades.

episodes_data.title: The Winter Social Season and Debut
episodes_data.description: The winter social season is here and Rosemyne must successfully finish her debut.

episodes_data.title: Winter Material Gathering
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne attempts to gather materials for her jureve once again!

episodes_data.title: Hasse's Punishment
episodes_data.description: Hasse`s punishment has finally be decided and Rosemyne must go to witness the results.

episodes_data.title: Night of Fruhtrane
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne visits the Goddess`s Bath on the Night of Fruhtrane to gather materials for her jureve.

episodes_data.title: New Dress and Printing Press
episodes_data.description: Brigitte tries on the dress that Rosemyne designed while the printing press is finally ready for a test print.

episodes_data.title: Holding the Fort During the Archduke Conference
episodes_data.description: With the archduke and his wife away, Rozemyne must stay at the castle with Wilfried.

episodes_data.title: Damuel's Proposal
episodes_data.description: The Star-Binding Ceremony begins and Rosemyne hopes Brigitte`s new dress will enchant the nobility.

episodes_data.title: Inspection of Illgner and Gathering of Summer
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne and her Gutenberg go to Illgner in hopes of finding new materials for papermaking.

episodes_data.title: Georgine's Visit
episodes_data.description: Georgine comes to visit and everyone in Ehrenfest question her true motives.

episodes_data.title: Ruelle Rechallenge
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne tries to gather the ruelle fruit once again. This time Ferdinand and Karstedt join to ensure success.

episodes_data.title: Wilfried's Actions
episodes_data.description: Rosemyne discovers Wilfried`s actions and a meeting is convened to determine the truth of the matter.

episodes_data.title: Charlotte's Baptism
episodes_data.description: Charlotte is officially welcomed to the Archduke`s family, but there is danger lurking in the shadows.

episodes_data.title: Rescue
episodes_data.description: Bonifatius rushes to rescue Myne, who has been poisoned and kidnapped.
